newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF to auction 6yr, 20yr, 2yr JGBs in Jan--traders.
newsitem.headline: MOF to auction 6yr, 20yr, 2yr JGBs in Jan--traders.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is likely to offer six-year, 20-year and two-year Japanese government bonds (JGBs) through price-competitive auctions later in January, bond traders said on Thursday.
The auction of six-year bonds is likely to be held next week and that of 20-year bonds in the week of January 20, they said.

The auction of two-year notes is likely to follow that of 10-year JGBs for February issuance to be held in the last week of January, traders said. Earlier on Thursday morning, MOF announced an offer of 10-year JGBs to be issued on January 27.
